summary: A deployment of orders version 1.4.0 introduced a NullPointerException in DiscountService when processing discount codes, causing widespread request failures across orders and gateway.

hypotheses.summary: Version 1.4.0 of the orders service introduced a code defect causing a NullPointerException whenever a discount code is null, resulting in failing order requests and elevated error rates on gateway and orders.

evidence.shows: Orders was updated to version 1.4.0 shortly before the incident began.

evidence.quote:
java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "String.trim()" because "code" is null
at dev.relay.sandbox.orders.pricing.DiscountService.apply(DiscountService.java:21)
evidence.shows: Version 1.4.0 introduces an unhandled NullPointerException when processing discount codes.

hypotheses.suggested_fix: Roll back orders to version 1.3.0 or add a null check in DiscountService.apply.
